entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: So basically, your group didn't go after[n]Okumura's life...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: And even the death of Shujin's principal,[n]who we found a calling card for, was the[n]work of another?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You don't sound like you're lying...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: If you wanted to deceive me, you could've[n]easily woven up a much simpler lie than[n]this "Metaverse."

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Moreover, your account coincides with[n]my own investigation. Is that even possible[n]if it were made up?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: And I hate to admit, but... with my line of[n]work, I know a false testimony when[n]I hear one.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Still, if you set your sights on Okumura[n]based on my intel, it'd be before his name[n]was even ranked.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You could've ignored him and targeted[n]some other famous person.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Why would you go so far as to further[n]investigate and pursue this criminal?
I can't ignore criminals.
My teammate was in danger.
We were interested.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Heh... simple enough.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: There's still no proof that another suspect[n]exists.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: That said, it's safe enough to say that you[n]aren't the murdering type.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But with the subsequent deaths of [n]Okumura and Shujin's principal,[n]the public's opinion changed.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Pressed to prove your innocence,[n]your next objective was...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Hm? What's the matter?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Is it a side effect!?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: What in the world did the police inject[n]into you?
My vision... is starting to get distorted...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Hey, can you hear me!?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ! You need[n]to stay focused!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: *sigh* ...Don't scare me like that.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: If what you're saying is true, you must[n]tell your side of the story to the end.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: We'll both be in trouble if your testimony[n]becomes unreliable.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Well then, let's move on.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: At last we arrive at your most recent[n]crime.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...You know what I mean, don't you?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: This calling card was delivered to your[n]latest target—the one you had decided[n]would prove your innocence.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It was addressed to "Sae Niijima."[n]...Myself.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Now, explain everything to me.
I feel like my bond with Sae[n]is growing deeper...
entries.uk: Здається, мій зв'язок із Сае[n]стає глибшим...
